lifecycle_rules.reply_obligation: Ordinary project messages may explicitly require a reply or a reply on completion. The daemon persists only the reply marker and timing requirement. Consumption and ACK never clear it; a correctly correlated reply from the current recipient to the original sender clears it atomically with the reply enqueue. The daemon does not infer business completion. Known idle with an outstanding marker emits one reminder per idle episode through the existing notification path; working and unknown do not. Reminders and replies default to no new reply requirement. Peer action results go to the requester; returning one result resumes the peer's own remaining work, and routine user reports are not required.
lifecycle_rules.work_specialties: Persist specialties by project and stable name. Project/category defaults, goal/category defaults and explicit task fields materialize one task policy. Roles are preferences; named executors and reviewers are requirements. Invitations, recipient acceptance, review acceptance, integration and cleanup remain separate facts. Changed delivery contracts invalidate old review acceptance; manual termination never proves delivery completion.
lifecycle_rules.loop: Every master goal, bug report/fix, master-to-subagent assignment, and peer task follows Trigger -> Work -> Gate -> State -> Stop.
lifecycle_rules.sequence: Declare board work and queue pending tasks -> claim or accept -> Verify -> Persist -> close applicable duties or record blocker -> inspect remaining work and blocker release -> continue eligible work or idle. Re-arm a consumed one-shot goal or deadline wake before the patrol ends when scheduling must continue. Recheck on the next authorized activation; no new periodic worker wake.
lifecycle_rules.role_default: Default identity is peer; master authority is user-authorized through explicit promotion or delegation by the current live master.
lifecycle_rules.wake: Ordinary peers may create finite, owner-scoped subscriptions for their assigned work. Project goal deadlines and master-idle reminders require current master authority. Managed subworkers cannot create independent deadline schedules. There is no periodic worker wake. A known-idle recipient with an explicit outstanding reply marker may receive one pending-reply reminder per idle episode; this does not start a new task or schedule.
lifecycle_rules.worker_idle_fact: On each worker working -> idle transition, emit one idempotent worker-idle fact to the live master; this fact does not count or control the master idle reminder episode.
lifecycle_rules.master_idle_episode: Master idle reminders are level-triggered. Within the same master idle episode, each reminder attempt consumes the shared episode-local budget, up to three attempts. An observed working change ends that episode; after three consecutive attempts without an observed working change, the episode stops. Worker-idle facts do not count toward this budget, and there is no scheduling-turn counter or automatic rearm.
lifecycle_rules.name_ownership: A project-scoped stable name is the work-attribution owner; the current agent sessionID is the execution carrier. When the same name remains with the current worker and its sessionID changes, update the name and all unclosed board assignments in the same logical mutation. Closed history is not rewritten. Old sessions are not admission gates; old executors are not notified, stopped, revoked, or awaited.
lifecycle_rules.sendmessage: Explicit collab sendmessage is immediate; idle, progress, delivery, bug, and worker-idle notices are auto-merged by the daemon in the 120-second batch window.
lifecycle_rules.bug_backlog: Bugs enter AppSDK or git-bug backlog with investigation evidence; P0 blocks the affected project.
lifecycle_rules.desktop: Desktop does not register goal subscribe.
lifecycle_rules.unknown_failure: Unknown name occupancy, timeout, and failure are preserved explicitly. Unknown occupancy keeps the existing binding and a durable pending request for Jenny arbitration; pending is a terminal result for that invocation. No ACK, fallback, or fake success.
lifecycle_rules.review_gates: AGY review is not used for Collab v1 lifecycle gates; ordinary and milestone review use an independent Codex OAuth gpt-6.1-sol medium Reviewer.
lifecycle_rules.legacy: Any 15-minute periodic worker liveness wording is deprecated and non-authoritative. Current v1 uses the task-bound inspect obligation, owner-scoped finite peer subscriptions, and current-master-only project goal and master-idle subscriptions.
lifecycle_rules.verification_boundary: The stable-name session synchronization, unknown arbitration, and presence/activity contract are target design for name-runtime-closure-20261020; source and runtime gates are tracked separately and were not passed by the T1 document task.

review_policy.milestone: independent Codex OAuth gpt-6.1-sol medium review

gate_descriptions.independent-review: Ordinary Collab v1 review uses an independent review path; AGY review is not used.
gate_descriptions.milestone-review: At the formal integration boundary, use an independent Codex OAuth gpt-6.1-sol medium Reviewer; AGY and Astra are not review backends.
gate_descriptions.loop-rules: Documented gate: each lifecycle is Trigger -> Work -> Gate -> State -> Stop and follows Discover -> durable dispatch intent -> Hand off -> Verify -> Persist -> Schedule.
gate_descriptions.bug-backlog: Documented gate: bugs are tracked in AppSDK/git-bug backlog and P0 blocks affected projects.
gate_descriptions.role-default: Documented gate: default identity is peer; master is explicit and user-approved.
gate_descriptions.worker-wake: Documented gate: ordinary peers can own finite owner-scoped subscriptions for assigned work; project goal deadlines and master-idle reminders are current-master-only; managed subworkers cannot create independent deadline schedules. There is no periodic worker wake. Outstanding explicit reply requirements allow one pending-reply reminder per known-idle episode; busy and unknown do not. Working -> idle sends one idempotent fact; unknown does not wake. Master idle reminders retain their existing shared three-attempt episode budget and stop after three consecutive attempts without observed working change.
gate_descriptions.name-work-ownership: Target design gate: name is project work attribution and agent sessionID is the current execution carrier. Same-name S1 -> S2 updates every unclosed assignment without rewriting closed history. Online occupancy requires this request's confirmation; unknown occupancy persists pending and waits for Jenny arbitration. Runtime verification is not claimed.
